name: State Merit Scholarship
description: Scholarship for meritorious students pursuing undergraduate education.
natural_language_rules: Applicant must be studying in an undergraduate course. Applicant must have a family income of at most 300000 per year. Applicant must be a resident of Maharashtra.

rules.human_readable: Applicant must be studying in an undergraduate course.
Family income must be at most ₹3,00,000.
